label: Diagram 11.4
caption: Diagram 11.4 Status of materials achieving class B-s3, d2 or worse as unprotected area
description: This is an isometric line drawing of a rectangular wall block, with "See para 11.7" at the top left. A vertical dimension labelled "b" marks the height of the green band at the top of the left edge, and a dimension labelled "a" runs along the bottom front edge. The front face of the block shows three zones. The top is a light green border surrounding a darker green central rectangle; below this is a plain white area. Three labels on the right, joined by leader lines, refer to these zones. The upper label points to the light green border and reads: "Area of fire resisting wall with materials more than 1mm thick and with a reaction to fire performance worse than class B-s3, d2 = a×b". The middle label points to the dark green centre and reads: "Area of wall counted as unprotected area = 0.5a×b". The lower label points to the white area and reads: "Area of fire resisting wall with materials having a reaction to fire performance better than class B-s3, d2". A green banner along the bottom carries the title "Diagram 11.4 Status of materials achieving class B-s3, d2 or worse as unprotected area".
